# Agility Accountants & Advisors

> CPA-led operational diagnostics and advisory for small businesses in Maryland, Virginia, Washington, DC and Pennsylvania. Agility normalizes a business's financials, benchmarks them against industry-average and best-in-class performance, and delivers a prioritized plan to improve margin and cash flow. Led by Robert O'Connor, CPA, based in Bel Air, Maryland.

Agility Accountants & Advisors is a Bel Air, Maryland accounting and advisory firm. Unlike a traditional bookkeeper, Agility turns clean books into an operational performance diagnostic: it compares a client's numbers against both the industry average and the best operators in their industry, identifies exactly where the business is losing margin or cash, and delivers a clear, prioritized monthly plan to fix it. The firm is led by Robert O'Connor, a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

Contact: phone +1-410-456-2433, email roconnor@agility-accountants.com, Bel Air, Maryland.

## What makes Agility different
- CPA-led, not a non-credentialed bookkeeping service.
- Benchmarks clients against industry-average AND best-in-class performance, not just generic averages.
- Translates financial data into specific, prioritized operational actions a non-accountant owner can act on.
- Focus on improving margin, cash flow, and confident growth.

## Services
- [Operational Diagnostic & Benchmarking](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/financial-analysis.html): The flagship monthly engagement. Normalizes financials, benchmarks against industry-average and best-in-class, and delivers a prioritized improvement plan.
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Clean, CPA-reviewed books that power the diagnostic.
- [Tax Planning](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/plan.html): Year-round tax planning built on the client's actual numbers.
- [Tax Preparation](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Tax preparation for individuals and businesses.
- [Business Formation / Reorganization](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Guidance on entity structure.
- [Estate Planning](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/services.html): Estate and gift tax planning, coordinated with the client's estate attorney.
- [Business Funding](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/business-funding.html): Financing guidance for growing businesses.

## Industries served
Small businesses in Maryland, Virginia, Washington, DC and Pennsylvania across many industries, with particular depth in construction and contractors (job costing, subcontractor analysis, margin benchmarking) and restaurants (prime cost, food and labor cost benchmarking).
